result.title: ViDecide: Teaching Video Diffusion Models to Reason and Plan Step by Step
result.summary: Current leading video generation models can synthesize highly realistic videos, while still frequently violating physical and logical constraints in multi-step reasoning and planning, even after training with large-scale reasoning data or existing diffusion RL methods. We attribute these failures to the conventional video training paradigm, which treats a solution as a fixed-length clip rather than a chain of decisions. We present ViDecide, a decision-centric framework that trains video diffusion models to predict state transitions causally and decide when to stop, with a decision-focused training schedule. We further propose Corrective Fine-tuning (CFT), which corrects failed decisions by mapping their noise to the model's own successful continuations, achieving stable improvement without policy-gradient optimization. Across abstract games, planning tasks, and a new benchmark of multi-step robot planning, ViDecide achieves an average strict success rate of 83.8%, far above 23.3% for standard fine-tuning and 67.8% for the strongest prior method, and generalizes to larger puzzles and unseen layouts. Our framework therefore unlocks greater potential for video generation models as reliable reasoners and planners in the visual world. Project page: https://kevin-thu.github.io/ViDecide.

AI.brief_summary: ViDecide 提出以决策为中心的框架，训练视频扩散模型逐步因果预测状态转移并自行判断何时停止，并用纠正性微调（将失败决策的噪声映射到模型自身的成功延续）替代策略梯度优化，在抽象游戏、规划任务与多步机器人规划基准上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接对应「STOP」停止决策、逐步状态转移与轨迹级监督问题，其纠正性微调也提供了无需策略梯度的贡献分配线索；但推理状态位于视频扩散生成器中，需核查其 latent 是否真正承载任务必要的视觉证据而非仅生成合理画面。
